assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome.
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further diagnostic evaluation.
The service is supported by diagnosis code I49.5.
The service is supported by diagnosis code R42.
The service is supported by diagnosis code R55.
